summary: Lando Norris overtook polesitter Charles Leclerc in the opening lap and controlled the race to secure McLaren's first victory of the season at the Hungaroring. Lewis Hamilton's afternoon unraveled with multiple penalties that dropped him from contention, leaving Ferrari to rue strategic errors that squandered their practice-session pace advantage. The win narrows McLaren's gap to Red Bull in the constructors' championship while Norris moves within striking distance of the drivers' standings leaders.
